boards.title: Your First Weekend at Northern Arizona University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that starts on campus and extends to Flagstaff’s public cultural and outdoor destinations.

cards.title: Start with Cline Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Use the library’s building and service information to orient yourself, find a comfortable study seat, and identify research help before the semester picks up.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for campus orientation and quiet time.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library is NAU’s university library and provides access to library services and collections.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current hours page before going; building access and service hours can vary.

cards.title: Get the campus lay of the land
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · University Union
cards.notes: Pause in the University Union to locate dining, student services, and campus resources, then use it as a clear meeting point for your new group.
cards.short_summary: A central campus stop for practical first-weekend logistics.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU’s University Union is a campus facility with dining and student-focused services.
cards.access_notes: Check the University Union site for current building and dining availability.

cards.title: Look through the NAU Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Old Main
cards.notes: Take a self-paced pass through the current exhibitions in Old Main, and check the museum calendar if a public program fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: Campus art exhibitions in NAU’s historic Old Main building.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAU Art Museum presents exhibitions and programs in Old Main.
cards.access_notes: Review the museum’s current visitor information and exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Try a Campus Recreation activity
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Recreation Center
cards.notes: Choose an available recreation option that suits your energy level, and confirm facility access requirements with Campus Recreation before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus option for an active Saturday morning.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU Campus Recreation operates recreation facilities and programs for the university community.
cards.access_notes: Facility access, programs, and hours are posted by Campus Recreation and may vary.

cards.title: Walk the Arboretum grounds
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · NAU south campus
cards.notes: Use the Arboretum’s visitor guidance to plan a daylight walk among native-plant collections, keeping to open public areas and posted paths.
cards.short_summary: A plant-focused outdoor stop operated by NAU.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum at Flagstaff is an NAU facility with gardens, collections, and visitor programming.
cards.access_notes: Check current visitor hours, seasonal conditions, and any admission information on the Arboretum site.

cards.title: Take a downtown orientation walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · historic downtown Flagstaff
cards.notes: Walk the public downtown streets in daylight, using the city’s visitor information to spot historic places and choose a public destination for a break.
cards.short_summary: A daylight introduction to Flagstaff’s historic commercial core.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Flagstaff identifies downtown as a historic district and visitor destination.
cards.access_notes: Use public sidewalks and follow posted rules; individual businesses set their own hours and entry policies.

cards.title: Spend time with northern Arizona history
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Fort Valley Road
cards.notes: Browse the museum’s current exhibitions and public programs for regional art, science, and cultural history; reserve extra time if a program is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A regional museum visit focused on the Colorado Plateau.
cards.evidence_claim: The Museum of Northern Arizona presents exhibitions and programs about the Colorado Plateau’s cultural and natural heritage.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current visitor hours, ticketing, and exhibition availability directly with the museum.

cards.title: Plan an evening at Lowell Observatory
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · Mars Hill
cards.notes: Select a current public program or observing session from Lowell’s schedule, arrive with time for check-in, and dress for Flagstaff’s evening weather.
cards.short_summary: An astronomy-focused evening program in Flagstaff.
cards.evidence_claim: Lowell Observatory offers public visitor experiences, programs, and telescope viewing opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Reserve or purchase as required through the observatory’s current visitor schedule; program availability varies.

cards.title: Meet Louie the Lumberjack
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · NAU campus
cards.notes: Find a campus event or public appearance where Louie is listed, then take a photo only where event staff and posted guidance allow it.
cards.short_summary: NAU’s named mascot connects a first visit to university identity.
cards.evidence_claim: Louie the Lumberjack is Northern Arizona University’s mascot.
cards.source_title: Northern Arizona University History: Louie the Lumberjack
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances depend on the event calendar; this is not a guaranteed daily activity.

cards.title: Close with a daylight trail walk
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Flagstaff Urban Trails System
cards.notes: Pick a signed, open segment from the city trail map, share your route with a friend, bring water, and turn back before daylight fades.
cards.short_summary: A city-managed network for a low-key outdoor reset.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Flagstaff manages the Flagstaff Urban Trails System and provides trail information and maps.
cards.source_title: City of Flagstaff: Flagstaff Urban Trails System
cards.access_notes: Check current trail conditions and closures with the city; stay on designated trails and plan for weather.

warnings: Museum and observatory admission requirements should be confirmed directly before visiting.
